title: Game.java — Battle Turn with Undo (Command)
text:
Nova  HP 66/80  [Aggressive style, gear: Suit + Cape + Shield + Gadget, state: OnMission]
Dr. Octopus  HP 90
State: In the field, trading blows with a villain.

Actions:
  1) Attack  (standard hit)
  2) Defend  (recover HP, skip attack)
  3) Ability (signature move, extra damage)
  4) Undo    (free -- reverses last action)
  0) Retreat (quit)
Your choice: 4

  Undoing: Attack (Aggressive)
  [Undo] Attack cancelled -- Mr Beast HP restored to 28.
